Koh Madsum, mid Covid 2020

Pig Beach · Koh Madsum (Pig Island)
This photo was taken during the middle of the Covid 2020 pandemic. It features a lone Jetski on an empty beach on an island otherwise known as pig Island but officially named Koh Madsum. Before Covid and now this beach is normally teaming with tourists.
